title: Google is putting AI in space (Project Suncatcher)

post.caption:
Google just ran AI in space. An AI chip in orbit answered a question from Earth.
Why? One AI data centre uses as much power as 100,000 homes, and in the right orbit the sun almost never sets.
The catch: space has no air to cool the chips. The next test decides it.
Follow so you don't miss Part 2.
